<js>
// ===== 工具函数 =====
function absUrl(u){
  if(/^https?:/i.test(u)) return u;
  var m = String(baseUrl || '').match(/^(https?:\/\/[^\/]+)/);
  return (m ? m[1] : '') + u;
}
function numOf(u){
  var m = String(u).match(/-(\d+)(?:-\d+)?\.html$/);
  return m ? parseInt(m[1], 10) : 0;
}
function _p2(n){ return (n < 10 ? "0" : "") + n; }
function edgeHeaders(){
  var d = new Date();
  var t = String(d.getFullYear()).slice(2) + _p2(d.getMonth()+1) + _p2(d.getDate());
  return {
    "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/148.0.0.0 Safari/537.36 Edg/148.0.0.0",
    "X-Requested-With": "cn.mujiankeji.mbrowser",
    "Cookie": "k=" + t + ";",
    "Upgrade-Insecure-Requests": "1",
    "Accept": "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,*/*;q=0.8,application/signed-exchange;v=b3;q=0.7",
    "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"
  };
}
function encBody(text, sk, iv){
  try {
    return java.createSymmetricCrypto("aes/cbc/pkcs7padding", java.strToBytes(sk), java.strToBytes(iv)).encryptBase64(text);
  } catch(e) {}
  try {
    var key = Packages.javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec(java.strToBytes(sk), "AES");
    var ivi = Packages.javax.crypto.spec.IvParameterSpec(java.strToBytes(iv));
    var ci = Packages.javax.crypto.Cipher.getInstance("AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding");
    ci.init(Packages.javax.crypto.Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE, key, ivi);
    return Packages.java.util.Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(ci.doFinal(java.strToBytes(text)));
  } catch(e) { return ""; }
}
function ajaxPost(url, body){
  // 与参考版一致：普通 java.ajax，不加特殊请求头（手机UA即可，被WAF拦会自动回退）
  try {
    return String(java.ajax(url + ',' + JSON.stringify({method: 'POST', body: body})) || '');
  } catch(e) { return ''; }
}

// ===== 第1页章节：兼容 人人书城/爱书库(chapListBody) 与 书友社(chapterList) =====
var hrefs = [], names = [];
try { hrefs = java.getStringList('class.chapListBody@li@a@href') || []; } catch(e) {}
try { names = java.getStringList('class.chapListBody@li@a@text') || []; } catch(e) {}
if(hrefs.length === 0){
  try { hrefs = java.getStringList('class.chapterList@class.list@li@div.name@a@href') || []; } catch(e) {}
  try { names = java.getStringList('class.chapterList@class.list@li@div.name@a@text') || []; } catch(e) {}
}
var out = [];
for(var i = 0; i < hrefs.length; i++){
  var u = absUrl(hrefs[i]);
  out.push({name: names[i] || '', url: u, order: numOf(u)});
}

// ===== 解析 id / 分页数 / AES密钥 =====
var id = '';
try {
  var mid = String(baseUrl || '').match(/\/(?:chapter|book)\/([^\/.?]+?)(?:-\d+)?\.html/);
  if(mid) id = mid[1];
} catch(e) {}
var pageCount = 0;
try {
  var opts = java.getElements('[data-aid="' + id + '"]@option') || [];
  if(opts.length === 0) opts = java.getElements('[data-aid="' + id + '"]@li') || [];
  pageCount = opts.length;
} catch(e) {}
var secretKey = '', ivKey = '';
try {
  var src = String(result || '');
  var mjs = src.match(/<script[^>]*src="([^"]*\/([A-Za-z0-9]{32,})\.js)"[^>]*>/);
  if(mjs){
    var jsTxt = String(java.ajax(absUrl(mjs[1])) || '');
    var mk = jsTxt.match(/AESCrypt\('([^']+)'\)/);
    var mik = jsTxt.match(/parse\('([^']+)'\)/);
    if(mk) secretKey = mk[1];
    if(mik) ivKey = mik[1];
  }
} catch(e) {}

// ===== 拉取其余页（java.post + Edge头） =====
var fetched = false;
if(id && pageCount > 1 && secretKey && ivKey){
  try {
    var baseHost = String(baseUrl || '').match(/^(https?:\/\/[^\/]+)/);
    baseHost = baseHost ? baseHost[1] : '';
    for(var p = 2; p <= pageCount; p++){
      try {
        var body = JSON.stringify({id: id, page: p});
        var enc = encBody(body, secretKey, ivKey);
        if(!enc) break;
        var resp = ajaxPost(baseHost + '/index.php?action=loadChapterPage', 'data=' + encodeURIComponent(enc));
        var obj = JSON.parse(resp);
        if(obj && obj.code === 0 && obj.data && obj.data.length){
          for(var j = 0; j < obj.data.length; j++){
            var it = obj.data[j];
            var u2 = absUrl(it.chapterurl || '');
            out.push({name: it.chaptername || '', url: u2, order: parseInt(it.chapterorder, 10) || numOf(u2) || 0});
          }
          fetched = true;
        } else { break; }
      } catch(e) { break; }
      try { Packages.java.lang.Thread.sleep(800 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 500)); } catch(e) {}
    }
  } catch(e) {}
}

// ===== 去重 + 升序 =====
var seen = {}, list = [];
for(var i = 0; i < out.length; i++){
  var k = out[i].order || out[i].url;
  if(seen[k]) continue;
  seen[k] = 1;
  list.push(out[i]);
}
list.sort(function(a, b){ return (a.order || 0) - (b.order || 0); });

// ===== 分页失败：用总章数占位补齐（不重复） =====
if(!fetched && id && list.length > 0){
  try {
    var bu = (typeof book !== 'undefined' && book && book.bookUrl) ? book.bookUrl : absUrl('/book/' + id + '.html');
    var detail = String(java.ajax(bu) || '');
    var mt = detail.match(/og:novel:latest_chapter_name"\s+content="第(\d+)章/);
    if(!mt) mt = detail.match(/\((\d+)章节\)/);
    var total = mt ? parseInt(mt[1], 10) : 0;
    var have = {};
    for(var i = 0; i < list.length; i++){ have[list[i].order] = 1; }
    for(var n = 1; n <= total; n++){
      if(!have[n]){
        list.push({name: '第' + n + '章', url: absUrl('/book/' + id + '-' + n + '.html'), order: n});
      }
    }
    list.sort(function(a, b){ return (a.order || 0) - (b.order || 0); });
  } catch(e) {}
}

var res = [];
for(var i = 0; i < list.length; i++){
  res.push(JSON.stringify({name: list[i].name, url: list[i].url, order: list[i].order}));
}
if(res.length === 0 && id){
  res.push(JSON.stringify({name: '第1章', url: absUrl('/book/' + id + '-1.html'), order: 1}));
}
res;
</js>
